name: application-call-log-row
title: Call Log Row
description: Call log list with contact avatar, a direction icon (incoming/outgoing/missed) whose color and glyph are both derived from the same direction value, duration, timestamp, and a real callback action.
useWhen: Listing recent phone calls in a dialer, CRM, or support console with distinguishable incoming/outgoing/missed states.
Each entry benefits from a one-tap callback action rather than requiring navigation to a full contact record.
Missed calls need to stand out visually from completed incoming/outgoing calls.
avoidWhen: You're logging game match results (win/loss/score) rather than phone calls — use `match-history-row` for that pattern instead.
There's no call direction to distinguish — a simpler contact list row is enough.
You need full call details (recording, transcript) inline — link out to a detail view instead of expanding this row.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width list (max-w-lg) with rows that keep icon and button sizes fixed; contact name and metadata truncate rather than wrapping onto the callback button at narrow widths.
accessibility: Direction icon color, glyph, and the visible label text ('Incoming'/'Outgoing'/'Missed') are all derived from the same direction value, so they can never disagree.
Missed calls are distinguished by both a red icon/text color and the word 'Missed', never relying on color alone.
The callback button has a descriptive aria-label naming the specific contact, not a generic 'Call' label.

variants.title: Call Log Row
variants.description: Three calls: incoming (answered, 4 min), outgoing (answered, 11 min), and a missed call from an unknown caller shown in red.
accessibility: Direction icon, color, and label text are all derived from the same call.direction value per row.

variants.title: Call Log Row (Dark)
variants.description: Call log row adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Direction icon and text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
